title: Dispensers.
officialText:
Toilet paper dispensers shall comply with this section. Where the dispenser is located above the grab bar,
the outlet of the dispenser shall be located within an area 24 inches (610 mm) minimum and 36 inches (915 mm) maximum from
the rear wall. Where the dispenser is located below the grab bar, the outlet of the dispenser shall be located within an are a 24
inches (610 mm) minimum and 42 inches (1065 mm) maximum from the rear wall. The outlet of the dispenser shall be located 18
inches (455 mm) minimum and 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum above the floor. Dispensers shall comply with Section 609.3 of
ICC A117.1.
